events.text: Your closest classmate pulls you aside after the bell and asks you to keep a secret about something that happened at home.

choices.label: Listen and keep it quiet
choices.resultText: They trust you more. At school, that kind of loyalty gets noticed.

choices.label: Tell them to talk to a teacher
choices.resultText: You push them toward help. It feels heavy, but adult, and they don't hate you for it.

choices.label: Gossip about it later
choices.resultText: Word spreads by lunch. Your reputation takes a hit with people who matter.

events.text: Your group project partner has done almost nothing. Presentation day is tomorrow and the slides are a mess.

choices.label: Stay up late and finish it yourself
choices.resultText: You carry the grade. The teacher praises the work — and somehow your partner still takes credit.

choices.label: Confront them and split the work now
choices.resultText: It's awkward, but they scramble. The project is average and fair.

choices.label: Tell the teacher the truth
choices.resultText: Staff intervene. You look responsible — and a little lonely at lunch for a week.

events.text: A teacher starts calling on you more and praising your answers. Other students notice — and not all of them smile about it.

choices.label: Lean into it and ask for extra work
choices.resultText: Your grades climb. A few classmates roll their eyes, but staff clearly respect you.

choices.label: Downplay it so you don't get targeted
choices.resultText: You keep the peace. You still learn, just with less spotlight.

choices.label: Use the attention to mock a rival
choices.resultText: You score a cheap laugh. The teacher looks disappointed, and so do people you like.

events.text: You catch your crush laughing at something you said in class. After school they linger near your locker like they might say hello.

choices.label: Walk over and talk
choices.resultText: It's awkward for thirty seconds, then easy. School feels brighter the rest of the week.

choices.label: Smile and keep walking
choices.resultText: Safe. Also unfinished. You replay the moment all evening.

choices.label: Panic and hide behind friends
choices.resultText: Your friends tease you for days. The crush probably didn't even notice — you hope.

events.text: The school bully corners you between buildings and demands your lunch money — or worse, your dignity in front of a crowd.

choices.label: Stand your ground
choices.resultText: It gets rough, but people stop laughing. Word spreads that you don't fold.

choices.label: Walk away and tell staff
choices.resultText: Adults finally get involved. Detention for them; quiet respect for you.

choices.label: Hand over what they want
choices.resultText: It's over quickly. The shame lasts longer than the cash.

events.text: Someone starts a rumor that you got detention for cheating — even if you didn't. The hallway chatter is loud.

choices.label: Ignore it and keep your grades clean
choices.resultText: The rumor dies without fuel. Your next test score does the talking.

choices.label: Confront the rumor-starter
choices.resultText: It gets heated. Some people believe you more; some just enjoy the drama.

choices.label: Lean into the bad-kid image
choices.resultText: You get a few laughs and lose a little staff goodwill. Reputation is a strange currency.

events.text: Your school club has a showcase night. Parents, teachers, and half the student body will be watching.

choices.label: Practice hard and take a lead role
choices.resultText: You shine. A teacher suggests you keep going with this outside school.

choices.label: Help backstage and support the team
choices.resultText: Nobody cheers your name, but the club runs smoothly because of you.

choices.label: Skip it and hang out elsewhere
choices.resultText: You miss the night. The group notices — and so does your club advisor.

events.text: Exam week hits like a wall. Everyone is tired, caffeinated, and one bad night away from melting down.

choices.label: Build a study schedule and stick to it
choices.resultText: Boring works. You walk into the hall knowing the material.

choices.label: Cram with friends overnight
choices.resultText: You learn some things and forget others. Bonding helps the stress, not the sleep.

choices.label: Give up and wing it
choices.resultText: Freedom feels good until the first question. Then it doesn't.

events.text: A transfer student sits alone at lunch looking lost. A few people stare; nobody moves.

choices.label: Invite them to sit with you
choices.resultText: They smile like they haven't in weeks. School gets a little bigger for both of you.

choices.label: Point them toward a teacher
choices.resultText: Helpful, distant. You did something — just not the hard part.

choices.label: Pretend you didn't notice
choices.resultText: You eat in peace. The quiet still feels wrong.

events.text: A professor's office hours are open. Your assignment is confusing and the lecture notes don't fill the gap.

choices.label: Go and ask focused questions
choices.resultText: They clarify the hard part in ten minutes. You leave feeling like a real student.

choices.label: Email a vague cry for help
choices.resultText: You get a polite reply pointing back to the syllabus. Progress: minimal.

choices.label: Skip it and copy from a friend
choices.resultText: You submit something. Understanding it is a problem for future-you.

events.text: The morning {transportMode} to school is packed with anxious classmates chanting memory formulas for the upcoming {primaryExam}.

choices.label: Quiz your seatmate and share summary mnemonic charts
choices.resultText: Studying together calms everyone's nerves. Your seatmate aced the revision quiz thanks to your charts.

choices.label: Reassure a visibly crying classmate and offer them your water bottle
choices.resultText: They wipe their tears with a grateful sniffle. Kind gestures on tough exam mornings are never forgotten.

choices.label: Put in earplugs and review your own notes in isolation
choices.resultText: You blocked out the noise and committed key science formulas to memory with surgical focus.

events.text: After acing a tough pop quiz, an older relative transfers celebratory pocket money via {moneyApp}. Friends at the school gate suggest visiting the corner snack shop.

choices.label: Treat your close friend group to warm pastries and sodas
choices.resultText: Laughter echoes around the snack bench as friends praise your generosity and celebrate your quiz score.

choices.label: Save the cash to buy recommended {secondaryExam} study guides
choices.resultText: You bought annotated revision handbooks. Your preparation for the {secondaryExam} takes a major leap forward.

choices.label: Donate the allowance to the school library computer fund
choices.resultText: The head librarian pins your name to the donors' board with a warm, approving smile.

events.text: Every morning at the {transportMode} stop, a gentle elderly vendor greets students with a warm "{greeting}!", making sure children cross the busy junction safely.

choices.label: Greet them respectfully with a bright "{greeting}!" and buy fruit
choices.resultText: The vendor beams and slips an extra sweet orange into your school bag. Your morning starts on a golden note.

choices.label: Help them sweep clean their fruit stall before the bell rings
choices.resultText: Their wrinkled eyes crinkle with warmth. Fellow students take notice of your courteous manners.

choices.label: Nod politely and hurry onward to beat the morning roll call
choices.resultText: You waved respectfully and slipped through the school gates right before the gates slammed shut.

events.text: A sudden tropical downpour turns the road outside school into a rushing stream, stalling the morning {transportMode}.

choices.label: Form a human chain with older students to help younger pupils cross safely
choices.resultText: Soaked to the knees, you safely guided every single younger child across the muddy torrent.

choices.label: Share your umbrella with a stranded classmate holding paper textbooks
choices.resultText: You saved their homework notebooks from destruction. They become a steadfast lunchroom companion.

choices.label: Wait sheltered under the store awning until the cloudburst passes
choices.resultText: You arrived dry and warm, even if twenty minutes late to morning homeroom.

events.text: Results for the nationwide mock {secondaryExam} are posted on the hall board. Your name appears in the top regional tier.

choices.label: Organize an evening study circle to tutor struggling peers
choices.resultText: Classmates flock to your study circle. Teaching the material cements your own mastery for the real exam.

choices.label: Celebrate with family over a special dinner
choices.resultText: Your guardians celebrate your stellar marks, cooking your favorite feast and praising your dedication.

choices.label: Stay modest and quietly double down on weak subjects
choices.resultText: You avoided jealousy and worked silently in the library, sharpening your academic edge.

events.text: During an ambitious chemistry experiment, a test tube boils over, filling the laboratory with dense lavender smoke.

choices.label: Quickly activate the emergency ventilation fan and switch off gas burners
choices.resultText: Your quick thinking clears the air before the fire alarms trip. The science teacher commends your safety instincts.

choices.label: Calmly guide coughing lab partners toward the open courtyard
choices.resultText: You ensured everyone exited safely. The fresh air revives your classmates immediately.

choices.label: Laugh off the colorful purple mess with your lab partner
choices.resultText: The spectacle was hilarious, although cleaning the purple soot off lab goggles took the rest of the period.

events.text: You represent your school at the inter-district debate tournament. The opposing captain is a fiery speaker with a fierce reputation.

choices.label: Deliver a razor-sharp evidence-based counter-argument
choices.resultText: The judges lean forward, captivated by your logical precision. Your school takes home the regional trophy!

choices.label: Appeal to the audience's emotional empathy with a stirring story
choices.resultText: The auditorium erupts into applause. Even the rival captain shakes your hand with sincere respect.

choices.label: Stick strictly to prepared team speaking notes
choices.resultText: You delivered a competent, steady performance that secured your school a solid runner-up finish.

events.text: On the final afternoon before {secondaryExam} study leave, classmates gather on the school lawn passing yearbooks and sharing bittersweet farewells.

choices.label: Write heartfelt personalized notes to teachers and friends
choices.resultText: Your kind words bring smiles and tears. Yearbooks capture a bond that distance will never erase.

choices.label: Organize a group commemorative photo beside the school crest
choices.resultText: Dozens of smiling faces crowd into the frame. The snapshot becomes a cherished memento for years to come.

choices.label: Exchange contact details and promise to meet after {secondaryExam} results
choices.resultText: You created a group chat to share revision tips, keeping mutual spirits high for exam season.
